name: Air-Fryer Smoky Eggplant with Garlic Yogurt
description: Cubed eggplant air-fried with smoked paprika and cumin until the edges are browned and crisp and the middle is soft and creamy, piled over cool garlic yogurt and finished with lemon, honey, and toasted sesame.

ingredientSections.heading: To Finish
items: Toasted sesame seeds (served on the side)

steps: Cut the eggplant into roughly 2-3 cm cubes.
Toss the cubes with the olive oil, smoked paprika, cumin, garlic powder if using, salt, and black pepper.
Air-fry at 195°C for 12-15 minutes, shaking the basket after about 7 minutes. Don't overcrowd the basket — airflow around the pieces is what gives you the browning.
You're looking for edges that are quite browned and slightly crisp with a soft, creamy inside. If your pieces are larger, give them another 2-4 minutes.
While the eggplant cooks, mix the yogurt sauce: Greek yogurt, grated garlic, a squeeze of lemon juice, a pinch of salt, and a little olive oil if you like.
Spread the yogurt over the plate first, then pile the hot eggplant on top.
Finish with lemon zest or juice, a drizzle of olive oil, and a small drizzle of honey. Scatter over parsley, mint, or chili flakes if you have them, and serve the toasted sesame seeds on the side.
notes: Don't overcrowd the air-fryer basket — cook in two batches if you need to. Crowded eggplant steams instead of browning.
